name: Opera AI
summary: Free AI assistant built into the Opera browser (formerly Opera Aria) for summarizing pages, generating images and analyzing files, with no account required.
description: Free AI assistant built into the Opera browser (formerly Opera Aria) for summarizing pages, generating images and analyzing files, with no account required.

pricing.details: Free in the Opera browser (Opera One, Opera GX, Opera Air, and Opera for Android and iOS), with no log-in or sign-up required. A free Opera Account is optional and unlocks chat history (saved for one year when signed in; six hours if not) and higher image-generation limits. Image generation is subject to fair-use limits; the official FAQ does not publish a numeric daily cap. No paid plan is published for Opera AI itself. Opera Neon is a separate Opera browser, mentioned in the official FAQ for higher image limits; it is not a paid tier of Opera AI. Other paid Opera features such as VPN Pro are separate products, not Opera AI plans. Official FAQ: you must be at least 18; Opera AI is unavailable in a private window and in a listed set of countries and regions.
pricing.label: Free

features: Free, accountless AI assistant built into Opera, with models from OpenAI and Google
Page and tab-island context: summarize, compare, translate (about 50 languages) and extract key points without leaving the page
Image generation, file and image analysis, voice input and output
Optional free Opera Account for chat history and higher image limits; no paid Opera AI plan is published
